## TL;DR
`repoos restart` restarts this repo's server whether it is a RepoOS service, an external launchd/systemd supervisor (including system-domain LaunchDaemons, the Kamrai case) or hand-run. This round fixes review pass 6: the locator could not find a server whose command line does not embed this repo's root.

## Work and rationale
- `src/core/serve-pid-verify.ts`: `verifyPidServesRepo` still accepts a command line whose root parses to this repo. For an installed RepoOS (`…/node_modules/repoos/dist/cli/index.js`) or a bare `repoos serve` shim, the lock in this repo's own cache dir is now the ownership proof: pass the lock's `startedAt`, and the pid is accepted when it is a `serve` process that started no later than the lock was written (plus 2 minutes of slack). A recycled pid starts after the lock, so it is rejected.
- `server-locate.ts` records `startedAt` on a lockfile-resolved server and uses the lock proof; `server-restart.ts` verifies with the same value before signalling. This matches `repoos stop`, which trusts the repo's own lock.
- `user-docs/troubleshooting.md`: the manual-command sentence now matches the code (a single `kill <pid>`, start `repoos serve` only if nothing answers).
- Tests in `src/core/serve-pid-verify.test.ts`: installed-RepoOS rejected without a lock, accepted with one, recycled pid rejected, non-serve process rejected, bare shim accepted, root-parsing command still accepted.
- Earlier rounds on the branch: system-domain `launchctl print`, `managed` kind, pid always verified, managed-port match, shutdown warning, accurate failure guidance, down-state hint.

## Approaches tried
Recording the root in the lock at register time was considered; using the existing `startedAt` avoids changing the lock format.

## Challenges and blockers
Not verified live: a non-sudo KeepAlive LaunchDaemon respawn, and whether `launchctl print system` lists pids without root; both are covered by fixtures.

## Key learnings
A pid guard must not be stricter than the lock lookup it protects; the lock is the ownership proof and start time guards pid reuse.
